toolsPreview.name: buy_dispatch_plan
toolsPreview.description: Schedules a deadline-bound compute, DePIN, battery or power-trading workload into an actionable German or European power window. Returns exact timing, expected EUR cost and savings, uncertainty, freshness, expiry and decision trace.

toolsPreview.name: buy_market_brief
toolsPreview.description: Returns licensed ENTSO-E and SMARD spot-market context for compute, DePIN, battery and power-trading agents: published day-ahead prices, volatility, load, renewable share when available, the observed share of published negative-price hours, uncertainty, freshness and expiry.
